ios.desc:
ADAK is the social network exclusively for college and pro athletes.

A new type of social app, ADAK is where members connect with other, elite athletes in their area to play any sport at their level. Browse a directory of local athletes, connect with other members who share your interests, and chat in-app to coordinate offline experiences.

Former & current, college & professional athletes may download the app and join the community using their latest athlete roster page from their college or professional team's website. Onboarding takes about 90 seconds and athletes are instantly approved by ADAK's AI-backed verification technology.

quotes.text:
I was an athlete in college and struggled to find community after joining the working world…

… so I built a platform to connect college and pro athletes in-person around sports and shared interests.

Would love any feedback on the app as we roll it out this summer! https://apps.apple.com/us/app/adak/id6444288312
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Where have you found community outside of work?
